title: Tech Note: The Possibilities of Form Macros
author: Bryan Yen, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Form macros remain a current, Project-mode-exclusive 4D feature used for exactly the workflow described here (form/object automation, dev-productivity helpers, conversion/error checking); the feature has continued to exist unchanged in later 4D versions rather than being replaced.
related_updates: Form macros are inherently tied to Project mode (.4DProject text-based structure) and formMacros.json/4D Class architecture, both of which remain 4D's current, standard project format and extension mechanism
No successor feature has replaced form macros; they continue to be documented and used in current 4D versions for form/project automation tasks
